visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black t-shirt and grey trousers stands facing a tan brick wall in an outdoor yard. Green leafy branches from a tree hang over the top of the wall, casting soft shadows. The man’s back is to the camera, and the setting is illuminated by bright, natural daylight. (2) The camera shifts to a top-down perspective showing the man's feet in olive-green rubber clogs on a surface of dirt and dry leaves. A clear stream of liquid hits the wall and splashes onto the ground, creating a dark, spreading wet spot on the masonry. (3) The man turns his head toward the camera with a surprised facial expression, his eyes wide and mouth slightly open as if startled. He is framed from the chest up against the brick wall background. He begins to move away from the wall. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a one-hundred-dollar bill lying on green grass. The bill is clearly marked with 'FOR MOTION PICTURE PURPOSES'. The surrounding grass is neatly trimmed, and the sunlight remains consistent and bright across the lawn area. (5) The man is shown in a wide shot running across the yard, repeatedly bending down to pick up numerous pieces of paper money scattered across the grass. The background contains a wooden fence, several large trees, and a partial view of a residential house. (6) The scene transitions to a brightly lit interior hallway with light wood laminate floors and white walls. The man continues to gather bills from the floor, eventually clutching a thick stack of money in both hands while heading toward a door. (7) The man opens a white paneled door and enters a bedroom. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a pink and black silk robe, is sitting on a white bed. She holds a green rectangular box and opens it toward the man. (8) Inside the open green box, a silver watch with a black face is visible on a display cushion. A green warranty card with text is tucked inside. The man looks at the watch and his money with a puzzled and excited expression. (9) A sudden cut shows the man in a different interior, lying on a black leather sofa wearing a light blue t-shirt and grey joggers. His arms are raised in excitement, but a large, irregular wet stain is visible on the crotch of his trousers. (10) A small white dog with brown patches jumps onto the man's chest on the sofa and begins to lick his face. The room is a cluttered home office with boxes, a printer, and a computer desk in the background.

It uses a sequence of increasingly lucky events—finding a yard full of money and being gifted a luxury watch—to set up a humorous subversion where the protagonist wakes up to find he has wet the bed, or been peed on by his dog, connecting the initial 'peeing' action to the reality of the situation.
